about: Hand-labelled filings from 1 Sept - 2 Oct 2026 used to build and test the colour rules (events.py). Favourable = good for shareholders on the face of the event; Adverse = bad on the face of the event; Unclassified = depends on details or context the filing does not give. Labelled from the filing's own text and PDF, before any rule was written. Judgement calls (dividend, buyback, ...) are the owner's decision and are not scored. The held-out split (30%, chosen by a fixed hash of the id) was not looked at while writing the rules. See LABELLING.md.
